intro.text: A squat Thaylen guard on Vstim's caravan who goes with Rysn to Relu-na.

items.text: When they met Axies on the way up, Nlent warned Rysn to keep away from the Aimian, showing some knowledge of Aimians mixed with superstition. He wears a charm of courage on his wrist, a reminder to be brave rather than anything magical.
